finding: Stat band table keyed by (tier, level, zone, instance) with fallback from exact zone to zone-with-instance-0 to global; each band stat fills only where the creature's own field is zero; a level change resets the band's own writes and re-applies it (zone/npc_scale_manager.cpp 362-406, 59-63; zone/npc.cpp 3641-3650). Band seed rows are not in the box.

Tier from name and flag: raid 2; named 1 when the rare flag is set, the name has a # prefix or starts with a capital letter; else trash 0 (zone/npc_scale_manager.cpp 554-567). The capital-letter test is a convention to replace with an explicit data flag.

Special abilities are one caret-separated string of id,value pairs, 57 ids, applied only to creatures that have none (zone/mob.cpp 7554-7562; zone/npc.cpp 2332-2333; common/emu_constants.h 525-585). Good shape for one swapped ability per named row.

Body size comes from a race and gender table: 732 slots per gender, 319 male and 317 female at the 6.0 default, out-of-range race returns 6.0; Lava Dragon and Wurm are forced to fixed sizes in the constructor (common/races.cpp 1398-1511; zone/npc.cpp 149-160). Keep size as presentation data, not hit reach.

Recolour by one tint id per row, sent to the client in the spawn packet; the tint table holds seven slots of RGB with a set name added by migration 710 (zone/npc.cpp 441, 2175; utils/sql/svn/702_aashieldblock_tint_table.sql 8-10; 710 line 1). Recolour tier with no new art.

Class-and-level damage factor (warrior 220 under level 20, 311 at 70 and over; casters 150 and 157) divides into base damage, but the factors are hard-coded in code, not data (zone/npc_scale_manager.cpp 143-146, 413-548).

Defects, keep the idea: no nearest-level fallback (a missing band leaves zero stats, npc_scale_manager.cpp 48-57); duplicate band keys dropped by emplace (275); static bake overwrites the npc_types row shared by all zones (645, 677). Fixes: nearest-level fallback, duplicate detection at load, per-zone bake or dynamic only.

Family is attack behaviour times idle mode. Archer, big monster and wild boar each have a roaming and a hold-position AI character that share one attack class and differ only in default idle (AiParams.cs 31-40; AIUtils.cs 34-57; AiCharacters files line 13). Roam box is 6 units per axis from the idle position (AIUtils.cs 16-19).

Active health-banded move lists: integer percent health; minimum exclusive, maximum inclusive; (0,0) always on; time window since combat start; weighted pick by dice (BaseCombatBehavior.cs 373-486, lines 380, 408, 447, 456). The big monster filter is inclusive at both ends (BigMonsterAttackBehavior.cs 91) and then picks uniformly among eligible moves with a base-skill fallback (lines 105-113). The two gates disagree on the boundary; use one rule.

Wild boar: one start skill once per fight, then a health-gated spurt (below a percent threshold) replaces the basic attack when in range (WildBoarAttackBehavior.cs 54, 68-117). Defects: the fallback pick runs once per spurt entry (115 inside loop 96); nothing happens when the target is outside spurt range (103-111); the spurt has no latch (99). Keep the idea, fix those three.

Stat equals a formula of level, template, kind and grade (Npc.cs 147-153), then bonuses applied in list order: percent as res times value over 100, flat as plus value (Npc.cs 159, 161; Unit.cs 687-705). Nothing fixes percent before flat. Formula bodies and values are in the absent client pack.

Grade enum is not ordinal: Normal 1, Elite 2, BossA to BossC 3-5, Weak 6, Strong 7, BossS 8. Kind enum has 13 values. Grade and kind feed stat formulas, not behaviour (NpcGradeType.cs 3-12; NpcKindType.cs 3-17; Npc.cs 153). Use an explicit ordered tier table for ours.

Group formation: 571 npc_group_members rows carry a leader flag, a move-leader flag, three offsets and a tension value. The loader reads them (NpcGroupGameData.cs 67-91) but no reader exists in the server half, so formation is data without a runtime consumer here.

Dead-code trap: FollowPathBehavior.cs lines 76-116 and 131-288 are a commented-out block with its own health and dice selection that looks active. Do not copy from it; the live selection is BaseCombatBehavior.cs.
